Position Overview

Clarkson University (Potsdam, New York) Department of Chemistry and Biomolecular Science has 2 fully funded PhD positions in Dr. Xiaocun Lu's Lu Research Group (PhotoMeChem Lab). Research areas: polymer chemistry, synthetic biomaterials, molecular mechanosensors, and bioimaging. Positions available immediately with priority to start before 15 January 2027.

Research Focus

  • Molecular mechanical sensors and nanosensors that detect force at biomaterial and cell level.
  • High-resolution fluorescence imaging.
  • Nanoscale biomechanics, cell mechanics, and mechanotransduction.

Preferred Background

  • B.S. or M.S. in organic chemistry or polymer chemistry.
  • Synthetic chemistry experience preferred.
  • Keywords: organic chemistry, polymer chemistry, chemical synthesis, fluorescence imaging, biomaterials, cell mechanics.

Funding

Fully funded (stipend plus tuition).

Eligibility

  • B.S. or M.S. in organic chemistry, polymer chemistry, or related field.
  • Synthetic chemistry experience preferred.
  • International applicants: TOEFL/IELTS if required.

Application Process

Email xlu@clarkson.edu with:

  • CV
  • Contact information for 3 references
  • Transcripts
  • Research statement
  • TOEFL/IELTS information if applicable
  • Rolling review. Early application recommended.

Official Link

Email: xlu@clarkson.edu

Important Notes

  • This is a directly funded professor's lab position, not a university scholarship.
  • Email the professor directly in addition to any formal university application.
  • Dr. Xiaocun Lu is an NSF Engineering Research Initiation (ERI) grant recipient (June 2024).
  • Official department name is Chemistry and Biomolecular Science (not Chemistry and Biochemistry).

About Clarkson University

Clarkson University is a private university in Potsdam, New York, United States. It offers undergraduate, graduate and research programmes in engineering, science, business and related fields. Its academic approach combines technical and professional education with research, supporting students interested in practical problem solving, interdisciplinary projects and collaboration with industry partners.

Official website: https://www.clarkson.edu

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 15 January 2027 (Priority). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
